summary: Issues and Answers was a once-weekly television news program broadcast by the American Broadcasting Company network from November 1960 to November 1981. The series was distributed to ABC affiliate stations on Sunday afternoons, to be carried either live or videotaped for later broadcast.
one_line: Issues and Answers was an ABC weekly TV news program that aired from November 1960 to November 1981.
